resources.string: When launched as the system assistant (gesture / hardware key), automatically attach a screenshot of the current screen to the new conversation. Requires the accessibility service; secure screens cannot be captured and silently fall back.
Set Minis as the default digital assistant to invoke it with system gestures or hardware keys and pass the current screen to the agent.
Minis can act as the Android system assistant, receive current-screen AssistStructure context and hand it to the AI agent.
